pages.title: Illusion Sword
pages.text:
RuneRegister (RuneRegister) -> Illusion Sword ->
Pops the RuneRegister, creates an illusion sword.

Mana cost 25 on summon, requires 1 mana per second to maintain form.
Disappears immediately when thrown from inventory.

On hit, executes the rune fragments in the register as a new spell, pushing the hit entity onto the new spell stack before execution

Hold right-click to charge (max 3s). Base cost: 23; each charging second costs 1% of max mana. Release to fire a sword wave – size and pierce count depend on charge time, damage depends on mana spent.
